name: SQL explorer
description: Read-only SQL through the plugin's own backend: against a Postgres the deployment runs, and with DuckDB over data files the deployment mounts.

cspNotes.script-src: Compiles DuckDB-WASM, the package's own assets/duckdb-eh.wasm, which completes the editor's SQL inside the frame.
cspNotes.connect-src: DuckDB-WASM reads its binary from a blob: URL the frame makes of that asset. No host is reachable.

secrets.name: postgres_url
secrets.purpose: The Postgres the explorer reads, as postgresql://<role>:<password>@<host>:<port>/<database>, for a role that may only read. Its host and port are the deployment's, added to the server network by a superuser as tcp://<host>:<port>.

widgets.name: SQL explorer
widgets.description: Read-only SQL against the deployment's Postgres or its data files

params.label: SQL
params.value: SELECT region, sum(units) AS units FROM sales GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

artifact.description: Runs a read-only SQL query against the deployment's Postgres or data files, in the user's own session, and shows the result in a table. Use it to answer a question about the deployment's data: write the query and set its source. The user can edit and rerun it.

skills.description: Use when the user asks a question about the deployment's data (Postgres demo schema, mounted files): the exact steps to show the SQL explorer with a query, plus the tables the example deployment holds.
